Type: Region (Beyond the Bonewall)
First Visited: Not yet visited

Description

The land beyond the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall}.
Whatever lies on the far side of the mountains has been kept at bay by the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Thirteen Spines} and their wards for as long as anyone can remember.
The name "Öuth Krelt" appears in a handful of ancient texts and military records maintained by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light}, always in reference to what the wards are holding back.
The name does not belong to any known human language — scholars believe it is a transliteration from whatever is spoken on the other side, recorded by Imperium-era soldiers or missionaries and never translated.

Almost nothing is known about Öuth Krelt in the current era.
The Light's official position is that the Bonewall wards exist to contain "forces of darkness," but specifics have been lost, suppressed, or classified within the church hierarchy.
Old maps sometimes mark the region with warnings or simply leave it blank.

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall} — The mountain range that separates Öuth Krelt from @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}'s territory
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Thirteen Spines} — The ward towers that hold its forces at bay
